title: Ask another node to do something
description: Discover /reset_robot, then create a Python Trigger client and receive its response. The robot starts displaced so you can see the reset.
steps: Discover the service in a terminal.
Create the Python client and call_async with an empty Trigger.Request.
Attach a completion callback and inspect the response.
hints: Try ros2 service list, then ros2 service type /reset_robot.
A topic streams messages. A service sends a request and receives a response.
